workspaceId.description: Workspace shortId or its existing internal ID.

summary.description:
Current state in Markdown, with one fact per line. Add useful detail beyond title and subtitle; do not repeat their information unless adding relevant new information. Do not wrap the whole summary in a code fence. Group related facts under a short "- Topic" parent bullet; put each supporting fact on its own "  - Fact" sub-bullet line with two leading spaces. Independent facts can stay at the top level. Preserve existing groups and unchanged lines when updating; add new facts within the relevant group. Example structure:
- Forecast
  - Sunday: Cloudy.
  - Monday: Rain.
- Advice: Bring an umbrella.

status.description: When reporting is enabled, create the activity with in_progress before doing the work. For every new task or follow-up, set the same activity to in_progress before starting. Use blocked whenever anything prevents finishing the current task; explain the obstacle and required next step in the summary. Return to in_progress when unblocked. Use done only after completion, never merely when waiting or ending a turn.

workId.description: Existing server-issued Work ID. Omit when creating an activity.

workKey.description: Existing internal Work Key, accepted for compatibility. Prefer workId for updates; omit when creating.

requestId.description: Stable retry token for creation; reuse only for an identical create request.

title.description: Required on creation; immutable afterwards. Use a short, generic plain-text title for the kind of work, such as "Weather report". Leave exact places, dates, versions, quantities, and current outcomes to subtitle and summary. Keep existing titles unchanged.

subtitle.description: Short plain-text context or current state. Put relevant specifics here instead of in the fixed title. Edit surgically and avoid repeating the title.
